component.name: Apache Pekko
component.description: Actor-based toolkit for building concurrent and distributed applications on the JVM. The linked security page covers receiving security advisories (via the Apache Announce mailing list) and reporting vulnerabilities (privately, per the Apache Security team guidelines; issues affecting both Apache Pekko and Akka should be reported to the Apache team first, which coordinates with Lightbend's Akka team). It cross-references further security-related documentation on Akka security fixes, Java serialization, the remote deployment allow list, and remote security, but itself documents no threats.

externalReferences.comment: Source security model document; this file is a structured translation of it.
